title: Atlas Policy Rule (grant)
description: The atomic authorization grant: these permissions, within this scope, on these field groups. Rules are assigned to users or groups (directly or via a Role); a subject's effective policy is the union of all reachable rules. Evaluated by the shared @atlas/policy evaluator on BOTH the server (enforcement) and Studio (UI gating). See docs/architecture/authorization-model.md.

effect.description: Base model is additive (allow only). 'deny' requires the optional deny extension, where deny overrides allow (authorization-model.md §7).

items.description: resource:action, e.g. asset:write, schedule:send. '*' is allowed for either part.

scope.description: Predicates the resource context must satisfy. An OMITTED predicate means 'any'.

categoryPaths.description: Category subtree scoping — each entry is matched as a PREFIX of the resource's materialized category path, so one grant covers a whole branch.

states.description: Resource lifecycle states this grant applies to, e.g. ["ready"].

ownedOnly.description: When true, only resources whose owner is the subject.

fieldGroups.description: Narrows a write-type permission to these field groups. Omitted = all groups.
